st1111:S10.summary: After a sales delivery was dispatched (shipped) the bin on-hand and reserved quantities did not change, so the demand form kept offering stock that had left. Call GET /api/inventory/items/location-inventory?itemId=<id> and note on-hand and reserved for the bin.

st1111:S10.expected: On-hand falls by 20 and reserved falls by 20 once the goods leave; a SALE row appears on the stock ledger.
st1111:S10.actual: After Ship (before gate-out) on-hand stays 90 and reserved still counts the 20 (observed 2026-11-11). Code says the drop happens at gate-out; not proven.
st1111:S10.where: backend DeliveryOrderFulfillmentService.consumeInventoryOnGateOut, consumeReservations; frontend sales demand form stock column
st1111:S10.verify: After gate-out verification of the delivery order, call GET /api/inventory/items/location-inventory?itemId=<id> and expect onHandQty 70 and reservedQty reduced by 20; read the inventory ledger for the item and expect one SALE movement of -20.

pt1110:A1.summary: A purchase return can only be made for quantity on fully paid bills, while the bill credit that refunds it must be applied in full to an outstanding bill of the same vendor. A fully paid bill is never outstanding, so the refund cannot be saved, and there is no cash refund path (money back from the vendor).
steps: Purchase > a billed local PO > Authorize Return: while the bill is partly paid the quantity box is disabled and RETURNABLE shows 0.
Pay the bill in full, create the return, fulfil it, click Refund (creates a Bill Credit).
On the Bill Credit, apply it: 'Applied amount must equal the bill credit total' and no open bill exists.
pt1110:A1.expected: A return can be refunded by cash or credit against the paid bill; zero returnable quantity is explained.
pt1110:A1.actual: Refund impossible; no explanation for RETURNABLE 0.
pt1110:A1.where: backend VendorReturnRequestController, VendorReturnRequestFacadeImpl, bill credit apply rule; frontend src/features/purchase/vendor-return/components/vendor-return-form-view.tsx
